integrity: Exact mathematical statement and all-parameter combinatorial Morse proof, with independently replayable finite face-poset enumeration. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only two-independence of singly whiskered cycles; no claim for arbitrary unicyclic graphs, general \(r\), equivariant homotopy, or shellability. Finite checks through \(n=16\) support but do not replace the all-parameter proof.
title: A four-periodic sphere-wedge classification for singly whiskered cycle two-independence complexes
